t: Organize and export your imported conversations easily, without a server

Import conversations from JSON files, organize them into folders and cards, search the text, and export them to Markdown, PDF, or a Notion-ready copy, all in a simple interface with no external storage.
A browser-based tool for managing AI conversations

You can organize conversations imported from different models in a simple in-browser interface, with no account or server required. The tool lets you create folders, apply role cards and tags, and search full text starting from any word or quote. All data stays in page memory only until the page is closed, and you can export it to Markdown, PDF, or a copy ready to paste into Notion. Enjoy managing your conversations quickly and efficiently on this site.
How can I import conversations from a file?
Choose a JSON file using the "JSON file" field, then click "Import". The conversations will appear in the list.
Where is data saved after the page is closed?
All data is stored temporarily in browser memory only and is lost when the page is closed; it's best to export it before closing.
What's the difference between Export MD and Export PDF?
Export MD produces an editable Markdown text file, while Export PDF creates a file you can print or share as a fixed document.
